items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: when I went to Detroit I started playing with Bill Johnson--Bill Johnson was one of the local trumpet players.

ctx.x: You had your own band in Detroit?

No. Well I went to. ---------- when I went to Detroit I started playing with Bill Johnson--Bill Johnson was one of the local trumpet players. And then we had a unique drummer that could play the drums, play the violin and sing, doing all of these things simultaneously. His name was Freddie Brown. He played the violin very well, kept good rhythm with the drums, and sang. Now, what would you call that?
